description: CIS Critical Security Controls v8 mapped to Legion telemetry data

rules.title: Unauthorized Software Inventory
rules.description: New packages added outside known baseline — unauthorized software may be present.
rules.remediation: Review and remove unauthorized packages. Enforce software allowlisting. Audit package managers.

rules.title: Unauthorized Process Execution
rules.description: New processes detected outside established baseline — unauthorized software may be executing.
rules.remediation: Identify and terminate unauthorized processes. Apply application control policies.

rules.title: Manage Default Administrator Privileges
rules.description: Privilege escalation alert detected — administrative rights may be misused.
rules.remediation: Audit admin group membership. Enforce just-in-time privilege access. Review sudo/UAC logs.

rules.title: Perform Automated Vulnerability Scanning
rules.description: Known CVEs detected in package inventory via OSV/CISA KEV database.
rules.remediation: Remediate all CVE findings. Schedule continuous scanning. Track CVSS scores and patch SLAs.

rules.title: Ensure Only Approved Ports and Services
rules.description: New outbound remote connections detected outside the established baseline.
rules.remediation: Block unauthorized outbound connections. Review listening services. Apply strict egress firewall rules.

rules.title: Scan for Network Anomalies
rules.description: Connections to AbuseIPDB-blacklisted IPs detected — possible C2 or compromised endpoint.
rules.remediation: Immediately block flagged IPs at the firewall. Investigate the connecting process. Check for lateral movement.

rules.title: Protect Sensitive Data via Monitoring
rules.description: Malicious or vulnerable AI SDK detected — sensitive data may be at risk of exfiltration.
rules.remediation: Remove or sandbox flagged AI packages. Review data flows through AI libraries. Audit API keys in use.

rules.title: Log Failed Authentication
rules.description: Multiple failed authentication events (Event ID 4625) detected in Windows Security Log.
rules.remediation: Investigate source IPs and accounts. Enforce account lockout. Consider geo-blocking. Review brute-force patterns.

rules.title: Maintain an Incident Response Plan
rules.description: Active malicious subnet connections detected — incident response may be warranted.
rules.remediation: Immediately block flagged IPs at the firewall. Investigate the connecting process. Check for lateral movement.
